selection_policy: Purposive, deterministic maximum-invariant-coverage illustration conditioned on nonempty native hints in all five arms; not a population-representative random sample. One case per eligible invariant. Within each invariant, prefer a bounded-verified TAR repair if available, then both traces at most 20 steps, choose the least-used eligible incorrect class (fixed UNDER/OVER/BOTH tie-break), minimize distance of the combined trace count from 8, then learner body length and case ID. Unknown TAR validation is retained and labeled explicitly. AI outputs were not examined for selection.
